# Del Piccolo Diavolo — Staffordshire Bull Terrier Kennel

> Ethical Staffordshire Bull Terrier kennel, active since 2013 in Ostellato (Ferrara, Emilia-Romagna, Italy). Responsible selection focused on health, breed type and temperament. Puppies are released with ENCI pedigree, parents tested for L2HGA and HC, microchipped, vaccinated, with lifelong support to the family.

Key information about this site:

- Breeder: Paolo Boldrini
- Location: Ostellato (FE), Emilia-Romagna, Italy
- Breed: Staffordshire Bull Terrier
- Bloodlines: English (Elitebull) and Irish (Lackyle)
- Achievements: Italian and international Champions, 4th at the World Dog Show
- Puppies are released with ENCI pedigree
- Site languages: Italian (main), English, German
- Contact: WhatsApp +39 392 4635584 · email zonerosse@gmail.com

## Notes

- The kennel produces few litters per year and carefully selects the families.
- Health and temperament come before aesthetics; no matings with diluted (blue) dogs.
- Italian and German versions of the site are available at the / and /de/ paths.
